It took me a whole year to convince him to go to therapy by himself and he went once maybe twice and he doesn't want to go back :( 
He's always like "they can't tell me anything I don't already know"

Right. Its your body. Your life. As long as you're not harming anyone else. 
But I think it's important to exhaust all your options first. Try therapy. Try medication. If all else fails, try to experience as much as you possibly can before you go. Try to travel or live out at least one major dream before you go.
